# Exported protocol regression fixtures

These are minimized exports from an isolated RC11 fixed-source experiment, not original transport envelopes or semantic Gold. The JD-B job description and task scenarios are synthetic test inputs. The role judgments are experimental model outputs and do not imply that the candidate was accepted.

The two response files retain the original application model_output values. Their transport/provenance envelopes are omitted. The Reviewer request export retains only the original output schema, system prompt and an original request-hash reference. The Coverage request export retains only scope_binding. Account/ACL dependencies, orchestration identifiers, absolute workspace paths and unrelated request context are not needed for these regression tests and are omitted.

The manifest records each original envelope/artifact hash, exported file hash, retained fields and canonical retained-payload hash. The original full request hash cannot be recomputed from this minimized export. Separate synthetic Gateway tests verify exact paid-receipt replay; these exports verify unchanged original judgments and application-contract values.

The source quotations come from LangGraph commit 302a4d4caf7fa90d78efa4e9f0636a6d72d24ac8. LICENSE.langgraph applies only to those upstream source quotations. It does not label the entire experimental dataset or model output as public MIT-licensed source.
